name: Pyat Santimetrov V Sekundu
source:
Memory loss. How do you live when you don't remember your entire past life?
I constantly dream of a certain girl...
I can't shake the feeling that I saw her in my past life.
...
Chasing a dream, in search of oneself.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1769513285]Steam[/url]]
translation:
记忆丧失。当你不记得你的整个前世时，你如何生活？
我经常梦见某个女孩…
我无法摆脱前世见过她的感觉。
…
追逐梦想，寻找自我。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1769513285]Steam[/url]]
